intro: One scoop of kangkung belacan is roughly 120 kcal. Kangkung itself is very low in calories. Almost all the calories come from the cooking oil.
diet: Yes, and it's encouraged because it's a vegetable. Just remember the calories come from the oil, not the kangkung. Take the kangkung and leave the oil on the plate. An easy way to add veggies when eating out.
tips: When ordering, ask for 'kurang minyak'. Most cooks understand.
Use a slotted spoon or drain the oil before putting it on your rice.
At home, stir-fry with 1 spoon of oil and a splash of water so it doesn't dry out.

swap.name: Blanched kangkung with sambal belacan dip
swap.why: You still get the belacan flavour, without all the frying oil.

faq.q: Is it safe to eat kangkung often?
faq.a: For most people, yes. Just wash it well because kangkung grows in wet areas.

faq.q: How do I keep kangkung green when cooking?
faq.a: Use high heat and cook it quickly. Don't cover the wok for too long.
Yes, belacan is salty. A little is enough for flavour, and cut back on other salt.
